name: Sikafloor®-31 PurCem®
tagline: Water based polyurethane cementitious hybrid coating
summary: Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® is a multi-component, water-based coloured polyurethane hybrid flooring coating. It has a matt, impervious, chemical resistant, hard wearing surface.
metaDescription: Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® is a multi-component, water-based coloured polyurethane hybrid flooring coating. It has a matt, impervious, chemical resistant, hard wearing surface.
attributes: Can be applied to substrates with high moisture content (7 days old or mature damp concrete or 10% moisture pbw)
usage: Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® is used as top and wear coat layer in Sikafloor® 22 PurCem® anti-slip system build-ups and as a stand alone coating.
advantages: Can be applied to substrates with high moisture content (7 days old or mature damp concrete or 10% moisture pbw)
packaging: Part A | 1.30 kg plastic bottle Part B | 1.50 kg plastic bottle Part C Pigment | 1.60 kg plastic bags 0.4 kg Plastic tub Part A+B+C+pigment | 4.8 kg ready to mix units

items.label: SUSTAINABILITY
items.text: Conformity with LEED v2009 IEQc 4.2: Low-Emitting Materials - Paints and Coatings

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Synthetic resin screed material according to EN 13813:2002,Declaration of Performance 02 08 02 02 004 0 000001 1088, certified by notified factory production control certification body 0086, certificate of conformity of the factory production control 541325, and provided with the CE marking.
Coating for surface protection of concrete according to EN 1504-2:2004, Synthetic resin screed material according to EN 13813:2002,Declaration of Performance 02 08 02 02 004 0 000001 1088, certified by notified factory production control certification body 0086, certificate of conformity of the factory production control 541325, and provided with the CE marking.
EN1186, EN 13130, and prCEN/TS 14234 standards, and the Decree on Consumer Goods, representing the conversion of directives 89/109/EEC, 90/128/EEC and 2002/72/EC for contact with food stuffs, according to test report by ISEGA, 32758 U11 and 32759 U11, both dated December 6th, 2011. items.label: Shelf life
items.text:
Part A | 9months from date of production.
Part B | 6 months from date of production.
Part C | 6 months from date of production.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The package must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Can be installed on substrates with higher moisture content. No ponding water. Check rising moisture. The substrate needs to be visibly dry and have adequate pull-off strength min 1.5 N/mm2.

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
Temperatures | Time
+10 °C | ~ 35–40 minutes
+20 °C | ~ 22–25 minutes
+30 °C | ~ 15–18 minutes
+35 °C | ~ 12–15 minutes

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Before overcoating Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® allow:
Substrate temperature | Minimum | Maximum
+10 °C | 16 hours | 72 hours
+20 °C | 8 hours | 48 hours
+30 °C | 4 hours | 24 hours
+35 °C | 4 hours | 24 hours
Times are approximate and will be affected be changing ambient and substrate conditions, particularly temperature and relative humidity.
Sikafloor PurCem Accelerator: the aid in the speed of cure for Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® add 5ml of PurCem accelerator to Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® to approximatley the halve time to return to service as above

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Premix part A with a low speed electric stirrer and then add pigment and mix until uniform. Add part B and mix for 30 seconds, until a uniform colour is achieved.
Use a double paddle (axis) mixer and gradually add part C (aggregate) to the mixed resin. Allow part C to blend for further 2 minutes minimum, to ensure complete mixing and a uniform moist mix is obtained. During the operations, scrape down the sides and bottom of the container with a flat or straight edge trowel at least once (parts A+P+B+C) to ensure complete mixing.
Mixing Tools A low speed electric stirrer (300-400 r.p.m.) and an Exomixer-type mixing paddle suited to the size of the mixing container to minimise the air entrapment.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: On smooth screeds apply the mixed Sikafloor®-31 PurCem® using a short or medium nap roller directly from a paint tray. On broadcasted screeds pour the material and spread it using a squeegee and then back-roll the excess using a medium knap roller.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.
